instructions_to_main_agent: Use Javascript (.js / .jsx) components as configured in the React workspace.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for high-end luxury scroll feeling.
Ensure all CTA buttons perform smooth scrolling down to #booking-form section.
The Hero Dual Mockup MUST be built entirely in HTML/CSS/React (no external image placeholder for the dashboard/chat).
The Demo Booking Form MUST collect selected date, selected time slot, clinic info and POST to /api/demo-booking.
Ensure zero transparent dropdowns or unreadable contrast overlays.
